summary: Respan's Span-01 Lite is a behavior-scoring model released 2026-09-26: for each plain-language behavior you define it returns the probability the behavior is present in a conversation span, suited to high-volume evaluation and monitoring. The respan/span-01-lite:free endpoint is $0 and rate-limited. It runs on the OpenRouter Decisions API (typed questions over a state — noul, choice, score), not the chat-completions endpoint, so chat SDKs will not work with it.
claim_steps: Create an OpenRouter account and API key at openrouter.ai/settings/keys.
Call model respan/span-01-lite:free via the OpenRouter Decisions API (openrouter.alpha.decisions.create) — not chat completions.
Free endpoint is rate-limited; pricing shows $0 for prompt and completion tokens.
